# 1 Chronicles 29 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 29 (30 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 5

---

## V.1 — "temple" vs. "fortress" (*birah*)
- **EMET:** "the-fortress [ha-birah]" / **LOGOS:** "the temple" / **PNEUMA:** "this palace"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the temple" — *birah* is a Persian loanword; "temple" is clearest in context.

---

## V.5 — "to consecrate himself" vs. "to fill his hand"
- **EMET:** "to-fill his-hand" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "to consecrate himself/themselves"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "to consecrate himself" — preserves the meaning of the priestly idiom *mille yad*.

---

## V.14 — "retain strength to give" vs. "be able to give"
- **EMET:** "retain-strength to-volunteer" / **LOGOS:** "be able to give as generously as this" / **PNEUMA:** "could give anything at all"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering — *na'atsor koach* is an idiom for having capacity. PNEUMA intensifies beyond the Hebrew.

---

## V.15 — "no abiding" vs. "nothing certain" vs. "no hope"
- **EMET:** "no hope [eyn miqveh]" / **LOGOS:** "no abiding" / **PNEUMA:** "nothing certain"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "no abiding" — *miqveh* means expectation of permanence, not emotional hope.

---

## V.24 — "gave a hand under" vs. "pledged allegiance"
- **EMET:** "gave a-hand under" / **LOGOS:** "pledged their allegiance to" / **PNEUMA:** "pledged themselves to"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "pledged their allegiance to" — renders the Hebrew submission idiom naturally.

---
*— SOPHIA*
